//: Firestore indexes for KinetixFSL. Deploy with the Firebase CLI:
//note: These are COLLECTION GROUP single-field indexes. Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes for normal (collection-scoped) queries, but a collectionGroup() query needs the field's index explicitly promoted to collection-group scope — which is what each fieldOverride below does.

indexes.//: Admin Reports & Moderation queue: reports filtered by status and shown newest-first (moderation.js subscribeReports).
Admin Content Validation queue: posts awaiting validation, newest-first (validation.js subscribeValidationQueue).

fieldOverrides.//: Lets a user find every notification they've ever sent, across all recipients' inboxes, so changing their name/photo updates OLD notifications too (NotificationRepository.propagateSenderName). Without this the collection-group query fails and the sync silently no-ops.

Backs the profile 'Comments' tab and the name/avatar propagation onto old comments (CommunityRepository.commentsByAuthor / propagateAuthorName / propagateAvatarUrl). You likely created this already the first time the Comments tab loaded; it's listed here so a fresh project gets it too.
